proposal.name: Check only pinned tests before ratification

plan.name: Check only pinned tests before ratification
plan.summary: Before ratification, configured repository checks run each touched part's existing format and lint checks and only the pinned acceptance selections through the captured test_one command or its framework equivalent, omitting the part-wide build and test commands because they do not establish whether those selections fail on the base. This applies to direct and queued planner checks and fresh final proposal validation for Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest; summaries name every pinned test by its full identity and report omitted build and test phases as skipped with a planning-scope reason. Build checks and CI still require all applicable declared commands and acceptance selections, while captured authority, dependency preparation, isolated invocation cleanup, failure evidence and shared deadlines retain their existing requirements. Update the named existing tests that expect base build/suite execution, suite-triggered planning deadlines or infrastructure failures in those omitted commands, retaining that coverage for builds and the commands and acceptance operations that planning still runs. Update SPEC.md and docs/factory.md to describe this planning/build distinction and its reporting, citing [#965's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-965.json) on changed SPEC bullets.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPlanCheckOnlyPinned965
tests.says: A public configured Go plan check runs its exact pinned subtest without ordinary tests or broad build commands, names its failure in the summary, and subsequent build checks still run and enforce the full suite.

tests.name: TestConfiguredPlanCheckDirectAndQueued965
tests.says: Direct and queued proposal checks for every supported framework run captured format and lint commands and only pinned selectors, preserve full identities in feedback, and still refuse already-passing acceptance tests.

tests.name: TestConfiguredPlanCheckAcceptanceBudget965
tests.says: When formatting and lint are inapplicable, proposal checks open only the pinned acceptance environments, start one shared test allowance before their startup, and skip broad commands even for a touched part without acceptance tests.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-3859048949/plan.json) and three acceptance tests to narrow configured proposal checks while preserving full build and CI checks. The first check passed, confirming all three tests fail on the unchanged base.
